name: Fables Wander : LK&P
source:
This is game based on Indonesian folktales Lutung Kasarung & Purbasari.

It's a visual novel so it has minimal gameplay and lot of reading.

[From [url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/666397]Newgrounds[/url]]
translation:
这是一款基于印度尼西亚民间故事Lutung Kasarung & Purbasari的游戏。

这是一部视觉小说，因此游戏玩法很少，但阅读量很大。

[来自[url=https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/666397]Newgrounds[/url]]
